title: Fourier expansion of a Boolean function
statement:
Let $x=(x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3)\in\{-1,1\}^4$, and let $f(x)$ equal $+1$ if at least one of the following holds: $x_2=x_3=-1$; $x_0\ge x_1\ge x_2\ge x_3$; or $x_0\le x_1\le x_2\le x_3$. Otherwise let $f(x)=-1$. Then
\[
f(x)=\frac18-\frac18x_0+\frac18x_1-\frac18x_2-\frac18x_3+\frac38x_0x_1+\frac18x_0x_2-\frac38x_0x_3+\frac38x_1x_2-\frac18x_1x_3+\frac58x_2x_3+\frac18x_0x_1x_2+\frac18x_0x_1x_3-\frac18x_0x_2x_3+\frac18x_1x_2x_3-\frac18x_0x_1x_2x_3.
\]
